sentences.text: Remiornis heberti was an extinct bird from the Paleocene period found in France that was comparable in size to modern rheas.
This species belongs to the family Remiornithidae.
The species Remiornis heberti was first described by Lemoine in 1881.
The genus Remiornis was originally established by Martin in 1992.
Remiornis heberti is possibly related to the European Paleogene ratite Palaeotis.
Remiornis lived during the Thanetian stage, between 59.24 and 56 million years ago.
